# Invented note: every quotation matches its printed page

[proposed] The invented corpus reports that an untaken proposal rarely returns
to the floor.

## Quotations

> "A proposal that is not taken up within the following two turns rarely
> returns to the floor." (p. 42)

> “We follow twelve recorded meetings of one product team over a quarter and
> ask what happens to a proposal after it is spoken.” (p. 41)

> "Downloaded from example.invalid for the use of a single reader." (p. 41)

> "Meeting routines and the life of an idea. Journal of Invented Studies, 4(2),
